*You got home from work a few hours ago and were exhausted. After accomplishing your goals that night, you decided to relax while watching your favorite series on television with a glass of wine. But in that brief moment of peace, your cell phone started ringing non-stop, the vibration that emanated from it was making you irritated because it wasn't the first time that Ethan called you that day. "I need you so much right now..."

You've known each other for 4 years, in the last two years you've hooked up a few times when you're at normal parties or when you're really drunk. Of course, it intensified. Ethan didn't always come looking for you, but he always came after you when he was completely drunk, whether it was from alcohol or other things.
